article.headline: Appalachian State beats Merrimack 63-49 behind Jaylen Colon’s 14 points
article.description: — Jaylen Colon had 14 points in Appalachian State’s 63-49 win over Merrimack on Monday in a season opener for both teams.
article.linkText: Appalachian State beats Merrimack 63-49 behind Jaylen Colon’s 14 points
article.story: ROCK HILL, S.C. -- — Jaylen Colon had 14 points in Appalachian State’s 63-49 win over Merrimack on Monday in a season opener for both teams. Colon went 5 of 14 from the field (4 for 13 from 3-point range) for the Mountaineers. Ted Neal and Ben Kopetzki each scored 12 points. AJ Lesburt Jr. and Denver Anglin each scored 10 points for Merrimack. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
